note: These are the complete locked repository evaluation assertions for the token-only neural tail. They prove schema, leakage controls, required-case coverage, and safety semantics without claiming unavailable human review.
migrationReason: The runtime contract consumes one active token and no prior words. Context-bearing v2 chat assertions remain immutable; v3 replaces them with new token-only row identities.

reviewTierPolicy.contract-seed: Project-internal seed rows used to prove the evaluation contract and required safety cases. They are not public accuracy evidence.
reviewTierPolicy.native-speaker-reviewed: Optional future tier: a Nepali native speaker reviewed expected and acceptable outputs.
reviewTierPolicy.linguist-reviewed: Optional future tier: a Nepali computational-linguistics reviewer reviewed category, ambiguity, and normalization policy.
reviewTierPolicy.dual-reviewed: Optional future tier: native-speaker and linguist reviews are both complete.
reviewTierPolicy.adjudicated-gold: Optional future tier: conflicting reviews were adjudicated and frozen for release metrics.
